meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

howto.what: 为 Claude 接入 DeltaChat 渠道:适配器直接驱动 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server 的 JSON-RPC 子进程,不经过 Chat SDK 桥接,消息以电子邮件收发并使用 Autocrypt/OpenPGP 端到端加密。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 添加 DeltaChat 渠道、在 /setup 流程中安装该适配器时接管;需先在 .env 配好六个 DC_* 变量,否则适配器不会启动。

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 的邀请链接和二维码找出来给我

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat channel to Claude: it drives the @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server JSON-RPC subprocess directly (no Chat SDK bridge), sending and receiving messages over email with Autocrypt/OpenPGP end-to-end encryption.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a DeltaChat channel to NanoClaw, such as during /setup. All six DC_* variables must be set in .env or the adapter will not start.

say_en.text: Install the DeltaChat channel adapter and run its registration test
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs deps, builds and verifies

say_en.text: Show me the DeltaChat invite link and QR code
Wire this DeltaChat group to an agent group
